required_consumer_behavior: Bind model/router/agent/tool policy versions, tests/evaluations, shadow/canary results and rollback evidence to the exact Sultan candidate SHA and deployment.
Do not let deployment acknowledgement or model self-reporting claim promotion success or production finality.
Block promotion on safety/security regression, missing preview canary, missing health/readback, unrehearsed rollback or blocking deferred evidence.
Return production observation through independent outcome/readback evidence, not the promoted candidate itself.
acceptance_proof_needed: exact Sultan candidate SHA and deployment ID
known_limitations: No preview or production evidence exists.
